text:
Aisha: Weekend check — leaning toward either tackling a very boring apartment purge + IKEA run (errands) or a spontaneous micro-adventure: sunrise hike + hunt down that new bánh mì truck. Who's in? :confused:
Tom: I'm down for the hike, but only if there's coffee and pastries after :coffee:
Priya: I have to do laundry but can join for the pastry part. Or I can take a shift on the IKEA run if someone helps carry a bookshelf.
Jordan: Ooh bánh mì. Count me in for the micro-adventure. What time?
Aisha: Thinking 6:00am meet at the west trailhead, ~3mi loop. Leaves time for breakfast. @Tom @Jordan @Lee?
Lee: 6am is brutal but fine. I'll bring a thermos.
Tom: fine, but I reserve the right to nap on the hike :zzz:
Priya: Also — does anyone need a hand with dog-sitting? My neighbor's out of town and I have space for one pup if needed.
Jordan: I can foster Leo for Saturday morning if that helps.
Aisha: Sold. Hike it is. If weather forces a pivot, we'll hit the IKEA + bookshelf plan.
ops-bot: Reminder: Office is closed Sunday for maintenance.
Tom: Perfect timing. I'll be back by noon for the couch assembly.
Priya: Bring snacks, Jordan. You owe bánh mì.
Jordan: I will procure bánh mì. Mission accepted. :fist:
Lee: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/hike-excited-14aUO0Mf7dWDXW
Aisha: Ok final: 6am west trailhead. DM me if you need ride. See you all :)
